rationales: Hacking is a cybercrime when used to gain unauthorized access.
Identity theft is a cybercrime involving misuse of another person’s identity.
Phishing is a cybercrime that tricks people into revealing sensitive information.
Decryption is the process of converting encrypted data back to readable form, not a cybercrime by itself.
Trade secrets are confidential business information, not an attack on a computer system.
Sabotage is a deliberate attack intended to damage or disrupt a computer system.
Copyright law protects creative works and is not a computer-system attack.
A patent grants protection for an invention and is not a computer-system attack.
The Background attribute is used in older HTML to specify a webpage background image.
Text specifies text color rather than a background image.
Anchor creates a hyperlink and does not set a background image.
Not all these attributes set a background image; Background is the relevant one.
Notepad++ can be used to create and edit webpages.
Notepad can be used to create and edit webpages.
TextEdit can be used to create and edit webpages as plain text.
All three editors can be used to create and modify webpages.
Act it out models a problem physically rather than dividing it into smaller problems.
Divide and conquer solves a complex problem by breaking it into smaller problems.
Prototyping builds a preliminary model of a solution.
Guess, check and improve tests possible solutions and refines them.

The

tag creates a paragraph and does not underline text.
The <u> tag underlines text.
The <b> tag makes text bold.
The <i> tag makes text italic.
Softlifting is unauthorized copying of software, not a way to read encrypted messages.
A patent protects an invention and does not decrypt messages.
A password may control access but is not generally the key used to decrypt a message.
Cryptographic keys are used to decrypt encrypted messages.
The <a> tag creates a hyperlink in a webpage.
The <b> tag makes text bold.
The <hr> tag creates a horizontal rule.

The
tag inserts a line break.
A channel is a communication medium, not the intended destination category here.
An area is not the usual term describing the destination of routed data.
A path is the route data follows, but the sentence refers to a different destination network.
Routing forwards data between devices on different networks.
TCP is a transport protocol, not an internet service provider.
HTTP is a protocol used to transfer web pages.
An ISP provides internet service to users.
SMTP is a protocol for sending email.
A·(B·C) is not generally equivalent to A+(B·C).
A+(B+C) does not generally equal A+(B·C).
(A·B)+(A·C) distributes A over OR, but does not equal A+(B·C) in general.
By the distributive law, A+(B·C) equals (A+B)·(A+C).
10110₂ equals 22 in decimal.
10100₂ equals 20 in decimal.
10011₂ equals 19 in decimal.
10000₂ equals 16 in decimal.
Encryption is the process of encoding data so it is not readily readable.
Sabotage is deliberate damage or disruption, not data encoding.
A patent protects an invention and is not a data-encoding process.
Copyright protects creative works and is not a data-encoding process.
1024 MB is not one megabyte; it is approximately one gigabyte in binary units.
One megabyte is conventionally equal to 1024 kilobytes in this context.
1024 GB is not one megabyte; it is approximately one terabyte in binary units.
1024 TB is far larger than one megabyte.
Test data is commonly classified into three types, such as normal, extreme, and erroneous data.
Five is not the number of test-data types used in this classification.
Seven is not the number of test-data types used in this classification.
Two is not the number of test-data types used in this classification.
